task_card.title: Latent preview: four consumers each re-implement the bus, and each gets it wrong differently

next_action.description: Ask Fabio to run his generations and watch all FOUR surfaces - Gallery, History workspace, Flows, Minimised Preview. That check is this session's first job and he asked for it explicitly. Read tasks/MPI-571/validation.md for exactly what is already proven (gallery card + the video-viewer latent layer, offline) and what is not (the Flow result pane must PACE AND LOOP instead of replaying the clip at burst speed per sampler step then freezing; the minimised window must MOVE instead of showing one still frame). If a run is a FOLEY run, read the DISPATCHED prompt back from Comfy /history - that also parks MPI-531. Do not write new code until he reports what he saw.

key_decisions: History was NOT a wrong re-implementation of the ring - it had NO SURFACE. Its `if (isVideo) return` carried a correct, stated reason: a JPEG latent cannot be painted into a <video>. So the fix was net-new UI - a latent LAYER on MpiVideoViewer's existing stage stack (setLatentPreview, z-index 2, between the player and the crop overlay) - not an extraction. The card's premise was wrong on this one surface; do not repeat it.

ownsFrames exists because making three more surfaces RETAIN frames created a hazard the single-consumer design never had: two retainers of one run, one revoking blobs the other is still looping (MPI-508's ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND storm, self-inflicted). VERIFIED rather than assumed - gallery/History/Flow are mutually exclusive by scope (scope:'gallery' mounts a placeholder card, groupHistory mounts the History viewer, flowService mounts NO gallery placeholder per MPI-306). The float bridge forwards every run regardless of scope, overlaps all three, must not own. Default false: leak over corrupt.

The float window's `seq` is now the BRIDGE's own counter, not the bus's. A looping player replays earlier frames, so a forwarded bus seq runs backwards and float-latent.html's newer-only guard would freeze the tile on frame 1 - reproducing the exact bug being fixed, from the opposite direction.
GPU ETIQUETTE HELD: nothing was generated this session, or in the two before it. Fabio has a Cubric-Prompt agent sweeping on the GPU. ASK before dispatching anything.
constraints: Bash tool: HEREDOCS ARE BLOCKED by guard-shell, and so are backslash-newline continuations. Write a .py to the scratchpad and run it BY PATH. Same for commit messages: write the file, then `git commit -F <path>`.

A python edit script must assert its match count before writing - two replacements in this session silently no-opped because the source file used an em-dash where the match string had a hyphen. `assert s.count(old) == 1` catches it; a bare .replace() does not.

MPI-574 (memory reorg) was running IN THIS SAME TREE concurrently and committed at 2c57098b/0b5b0f65 mid-session. Its files.json is INCOMPLETE - docs/comfy.md, docs/models/ltx/audio-input.md and docs/workflow-authoring/bench-editing.md were modified but are not listed. Check `git status` before assuming an unexpected modified file is yours.

Driving the app offline needs no GPU and no project: `npm run app:isolated` prints READY <url> on its own free port and profile, and MpiGalleryGrid can be mounted into a detached div with a synthetic `{id, type:'video', history:[], isGenerating:true}` group - then grid.el.updatePreview(groupId, url, clip) drives the real playback path. _cardMap is keyed by GROUP id, not tempId. Use data: URLs, not blob: - the player only revokes blob:.

Tear the isolated instance down by PID via PowerShell: `powershell -NoProfile -Command "taskkill.exe /PID <pid> /T /F"` (Git Bash mangles a bare /PID). Find the pid with Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort <port> -State Listen.
